description: This header file declares external API functions for an Object Mapper component within the Advanced Networking Service Container (ANSC) project. It contains function prototypes for creating object mapper and object descriptor instances, along with license and documentation comments.

methods.name: AnscCreateObjectMapper
methods.description: Prototype for a function that creates and returns an object mapper handle, taking a context handle as input.

methods.name: AnscCreateObjectDescriptor
methods.description: Prototype for a function that creates and returns an object descriptor handle, taking a context handle as input.
